description: This file defines platform-specific functions for checking and upgrading firmware images for a particular hardware platform within an OpenWRT build system. It includes functions for image validation and a default upgrade process based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to check the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function to perform firmware upgrade; defaults to 'default_do_upgrade' unless specific board is matched.
